messages:
mira: Quick heads-up 1: we rolled micro-batching + KV prefetch to canary (rw-v2-medium) in us-west-2 cap-1. Early readouts: p50 102ms -> 78ms (~24%), p95 460ms -> 360ms (~22%); token cost estimate ~17% lower for steady chat loads. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/runtime/kv-prefetch-canary :tada:

sam: Nice! Which flags flipped?

mira: runtime.flags: kv_prefetch=true, kv_prefetch_trigger=64, micro_batch_window_ms=6, max_batch_size=48. Prefetch capped per-GPU to avoid OOMs.

jules: Saw a tiny p99 bump for very long contexts on one host during first 10m. Is there an auto-rollback?

mira: Yes 1: auto-rollback if >10% p99 regression on >4k context for 5m or any GPU OOM. We already rolled one host back and it smoothed out.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started service=runtime-worker group=cap-1 region=us-west-2 build=sha256:ea7b9c

sam: Do customers need SDK updates?

mira: No changes to SDKs or API. It's purely runtime-side. We'll publish a short product note and an internal post with per-model numbers.

mira: Plan: monitor for 4 hours, then staged regional rollout if stable. Will post another update at +2h. :rocket:
